Custom Orthotics Manufacturing

Configuration Business Flows Flow 1: Purchase Flow 2: B2B Customer Flow 3: B2C Customer

Configuration

EAN/UPC Code: Rename the barcode field label. This ensures every product has a unique global identifier.

Item No: A new field for the part manufacturer, useful for identifying original parts used in device manufacturing.

Brands: A new field specifying which brands a product supports, providing clarity for compatibility.

Business Flows

Flow 1: Purchase

  1. Create an RFQ for the vendor and select the products, then send the RFQ via email.
  2. Negotiate prices via email, update the RFQ, and confirm it to generate a purchase order (PO).
  3. Upon PO confirmation, receive products, add quantities to "Done quantities," and validate receipts with lot and serial numbers if applicable.

Flow 2: B2B Customer

  1. Use the standard sales process: create a quotation, select products, and send the quotation via email. Confirm it to generate a sales order (SO) after negotiation.
  2. Enable warranty management by activating "Lot & Serial No." on the product form and setting an expiration date. The expiration date will auto-update upon delivery.

Flow 3: B2C Customer

  1. Use the Sales Management module to add products customers wish to purchase.
  2. Manage warranties similarly to B2B by enabling "Lot & Serial No." and expiration dates on product forms.

File Attachment Object Store

Overview: This mechanism enables attachment storage in external systems like S3 or NFS, ideal for multi-server architectures ensuring redundancy and scalability.

Features:

  • Filename retains meaning: Stored as <name>-<attachment-id>-<version>.<extension>.
  • Provides Internal URL and Filesystem URL for file access.
  • Supports streaming content between external filesystems and Odoo clients for efficiency.

Configuration:

  1. Navigate to Settings > Technical > File Storage to create a new storage.
  2. Set options like Optimized Directory Path, Autovacuum GC, and Default for Attachments.
  3. Define storage rules for models/fields via `file.storage` or server environment files.

Advanced Options:

  • Base URL: For accessing attachments via external storage URLs.
  • X-Sendfile Support: For serving files efficiently via a proxy (e.g., Nginx).
  • Filename Obfuscation: Useful for enhanced privacy and SEO-sensitive setups.
